quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: [Vent Flow 151-1] Hydrothermal vents release superheated mineral compounds, rich in hydrogen ____, into the pitch-black ocean depth.
quests.hint: Recall the chemical compounds that are typical of deep hot water volcanic vents. (Diving calibration index 151-1)
quests.explanation: Vents emit high amounts of toxic hydrogen sulfide, which forms the chemical basis of life. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 151].

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: [Microbe Dark 151-2] In complete darkness, deep bacteria perform ____ to synthesize organic nutrients from chemical energy.
quests.hint: Focus on the chemical-based food synthesis process of dark subsea microbes. (Diving calibration index 151-2)
quests.explanation: Since sunlight is absent, deep-sea bacteria must use chemosynthesis to convert sulfide into food. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 151].

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: [Forest Base 151-3] Giant kelp forests anchor themselves firmly to the rocky seabed using root-like structural ____.
quests.hint: Identify the root-like structures kelp plants use to stay anchored in strong currents. (Diving calibration index 151-3)
quests.explanation: Holdfasts are the specialized anchoring structures kelp uses to cling to underwater rocks. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 151].

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: [Biolum Glow 152-1] Nearly 90% of deep-sea species have evolved bioluminescence using a chemical pigment called ____.
quests.hint: Recall the glowing chemical pigment responsible for cold subsea light. (Diving calibration index 152-1)
quests.explanation: Luciferin is the primary light-emitting chemical compound that produces biological glow. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 152].

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: [Upwell Bloom 152-2] Wind-driven coastal upwelling lifts nutrient-packed cold deep water to the surface, sparking massive plankton ____.
quests.hint: Focus on the term used for the rapid population growth of microscopic algae or plankton. (Diving calibration index 152-2)
quests.explanation: The massive explosion of phytoplankton triggered by nutrient upwellings is called a bloom. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 152].
